title.en: An Act Authorizing the Governor-General to Convey or Lease to the Provinces and Municipalities the Private Property of the Insular Government.
title.orig: An Act Authorizing the Governor-General to Convey or Lease to the Provinces and Municipalities the Private Property of the Insular Government.

text.en:
In all cases in which the Insular Government owns real property in any province or municipality
of the Philippine Islands, and in which the provincial or municipal authorities, as the case may be, desire to
acquire or lease the said property, or to exchange for it property belonging to the province of the municipality
the Governor-General is hereby authorized and empowered to donate, sell, lease, exchange or in any other
manner convey the said property of the Insular Government, or any part thereof, to any province or
municipality wherein it may be situated, and upon such terms and conditions as in his discretion may be most
convenient for the interest of the Insular government any contracts, deeds, leases, or other instruments which
may be necessary to execute the donation, sale, lease, exchange or other conveyance whatsoever of the said
property, as aforesaid: Provided however, That this Act shall not be construed to modify or repeal any existing
Acts that provide for the sale or lease under certain conditions of public property belonging to the Insular
Government.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, May 10, 1909.
